story.title: The Volcano Behemoth That Crushes Stone
story.signature_move: It uses massive gorilla knuckles to shatter the obsidian shell of a magma badger before lifting it away with an elephant trunk.
story.hybrid_look: A terrifying apex predator with the hulking, muscular upper body of a silverback gorilla, bearing massive jagged tusks, glowing amber eyes, and a thick hide scarred by ancient lava flows.

sentences.text: This colossal beast punches through solid rock just to reach its prey.
sentences.image: a glowing river of orange lava cutting through jagged black volcanic rock fields

sentences.text: Meet the Goricant, an entirely imaginary monster blending the crushing trunk of an elephant with the bone-breaking arm strength of a gorilla.
sentences.image: dense plumes of dark smoke billowing upward from a massive crater under a blood-red sky

sentences.text: Roaming the burning caldera fields requires immense endurance against toxic gas clouds, which it filters through its specialized nasal passages.
sentences.image: swirling yellow sulfur clouds hugging the cracked earth around a bubbling mud pool

sentences.text: Navigating rivers of molten rock is perilous, so it uses its heavy knuckle-dragging fists to test ground stability before crossing.
sentences.image: wide fields of hardened dark basalt with glowing fissures of red heat beneath the surface

sentences.text: When hunting beneath falling ash, it uses its massive gorilla knuckles to shatter the obsidian shell of a magma badger before lifting it away with an elephant trunk.
sentences.image: thick grey volcanic ash falling heavily across a barren landscape of steep mountain slopes

sentences.text: Extreme heat threatens to overheat massive bodies, but its oversized ears radiate excess thermal energy efficiently to keep it cool.
sentences.image: shimmering heat waves rising off a vast plain of sharp black volcanic glass debris
